title: Baobab-Platform capability-centric domain identifiers and enumerations
description: Canonical identifiers and enumerations for the capability-centric platform model (ADR-BCP-002 through ADR-BCP-009, ADR-SHARED-007). This package defines vocabulary only; baobab-platform/baobab-cp is the runtime authority that persists, evaluates and resolves these concepts.

capabilityKey.description: Implementation-neutral capability identity in <domain>.<resource>.<action> form, e.g. "commerce.order.create". Must never contain a vendor name (medusa, idempiere, payload, haystack), a tenant name, or a region/country name. The key is stable across provider replacement: moving a capability from one provider to another never renames it.

capabilityDomain.description: Governed top-level namespace for a capability key's first segment. A new top-level domain requires an architecture review and an update to this enum; see namespace-registry.yaml for rationale per domain.

capabilityId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a registered Capability. Never derived from the capability_key.

capabilityDependencyType.description: Whether a depended-upon capability must, may, or conditionally must be satisfied.

capabilityLifecycle.description: Operational lifecycle of a Capability, CapabilityProvider or CapabilityBinding. Distinct from maturity: a capability can be maturity=SUPPORTED and lifecycle=SUSPENDED simultaneously.

capabilityMaturity.description: Confidence/support level of a Capability's contract and implementation. Distinct from lifecycle.

capabilityCompositionType.description: Classification of a CapabilityComposition. Governs how it may be combined with others, not runtime behaviour.

capabilityMembershipCriticality.description: Criticality of one capability's membership within one specific composition. The same capability can be MANDATORY in one composition and OPTIONAL in another.

capabilityScopeId.description: Identifier for a CapabilityScope. Deliberately distinct from mapping.mappingScopeId (contracts/control-plane/v1/domain.schema.json): the two share dimension vocabulary but are not the same object, per ADR-SHARED-007 §25.

capabilityGrantStatus.description: Lifecycle of a CapabilityGrant. A grant is effective only when status=ACTIVE and the current time falls within [effective_from, effective_to).

capabilityGrantSource.description: Provenance of a CapabilityGrant. Multiple independent grants from different sources may coexist for the same tenant/capability/scope; revoking one source does not revoke grants from another.

capabilityProviderKey.description: Provider identity in <engine-id>.<provider-name> form, e.g. "baobab-trade.medusa", "baobab-erp.idempiere", "baobab-payments.sandbox", "baobab-iam.ory". The first segment is the engine that owns the provider (control-plane/v1 engineId, ADR-SHARED-012), never a technology family; the second names the provider within that engine and is usually its implementationKey. One engine may own several providers, e.g. baobab-iam.keycloak and baobab-iam.ory (ADR-SHARED-017 SS8-9, SS23).

capabilityProviderType.description: Kind of implementation a CapabilityProvider represents.

providerHealthStatus.description: Ephemeral operational health of a provider or engine instance, distinct from lifecycle. Health is never persisted as a substitute for lifecycle state.

capabilityHealthCriticality.description: Which provider health a capability tolerates (ADR-BCP-006 SS22). A per-capability policy, independent of any composition's membership criticality. CRITICAL, e.g. payment authorisation: only HEALTHY is eligible. STANDARD: HEALTHY or UNKNOWN. See health-policy.yaml.

healthObservationSource.description: How a HealthObservation (health.schema.json) was obtained. ACTIVE_PROBE: the Control Plane called the subject's health endpoint. PASSIVE_TELEMETRY: derived from the subject's observed request outcomes. ENGINE_REPORT: the engine instance reported its own health under its workload identity. OPERATOR: an authenticated operator recorded it. A closed set, so it is safe as a bounded metric label.

healthReasonCode.description: A code registered in the health_observation category of contracts/authorization/v1/reason-code-registry.yaml.

bindingMode.description: Canonical binding mode (locked by BCP-TS-ONBOARDING-001 CR-002, confirmed in baobab-platform/baobab-cp Phase-0 audit against ADR-SHARED-007's own independent proposal of the same five values). PRIMARY: normal authoritative binding. FALLBACK: eligible only under approved failover conditions, never a bypass of entitlement/scope/contract/residency/isolation checks. SHADOW: non-authoritative mirrored execution, never determines the business result. MIGRATION: temporary binding participating in an explicit ProviderMigration plan. DISABLED: retained but excluded from resolution. No other value is valid; a superseded seven-value set (including SECONDARY, READ_ONLY, MIGRATION_SOURCE, MIGRATION_TARGET) existed in early baobab-platform/baobab-cp migrations and must not be reintroduced -- see this schema's own README.md for the rationale.

engineKey.description: TRANSITIONAL (ADR-SHARED-017 SS9). The v1 provider field whose meaning has drifted between technology family ("medusa", "idempiere") and provider label ("sandbox-payments", "temporary-billing"). Kept unchanged for v1 compatibility; the next capability contract major removes it. New contracts name the Baobab engine with control-plane/v1 engineId (e.g. "baobab-trade"), the provider with capabilityProviderKey and the technology family with implementationKey. An engine key never defines Baobab product identity.

implementationKey.description: The implementation technology or provider family beneath a CapabilityProvider, e.g. "medusa", "idempiere", "payload", "haystack", "keycloak", "ory", "hyperswitch", "killbill", "sandbox" (ADR-SHARED-017 SS8-9). Distinct from the engine (control-plane/v1 engineId, e.g. "baobab-trade") and from the provider (capabilityProviderKey, e.g. "baobab-trade.medusa"). Never part of a capability key.

providerImplementationStatus.description: How complete an engine repository says its implementation of one capability contract is (ADR-SHARED-017 SS25). PARTIAL: part of the contract is implemented; never registered as provider support. IMPLEMENTED: the declared contract majors are implemented, with implementation evidence. Deliberately not a lifecycle, certification or health value: ACTIVE belongs to the Control Plane, CERTIFIED to EA-09 and HEALTHY to HealthObservation.

capabilityProposalStatus.description: Architecture-workflow state of a planned capability (ADR-SHARED-017 SS16-17). CANDIDATE: found during census, not yet proposed. PROPOSED: under architecture review. CONTRACTING: the Shared contract is being written. CONTRACTED: the canonical Shared definition exists, but this provider does not implement it yet. Never a runtime lifecycle: a planned capability creates no Capability, ProviderCapabilitySupport or CapabilityBinding, satisfies no composition and never takes part in resolution.

implementationEvidenceType.description: Kind of repository artefact behind an implementation claim (ADR-SHARED-017 SS47). Evidence explains why a repository claims an implementation exists; it is not certification, which EA-09 owns.

architectureDecisionId.description: Identifier of a governing architecture decision record, e.g. "ADR-SHARED-017", "ADR-BCP-006", "ADR-PAY-0002", "ADR-0020".

platformRepository.description: A repository of the baobab-platform GitHub organisation in owner/name form, e.g. "baobab-platform/baobab-payments".

capabilityResolutionDecision.description: Outcome of a capability resolution request.
